name: Saxon Capital Group, Inc.
summary: Saxon Capital Group, Inc. is engaged in the development, ownership, and management of energy ventures and exploration opportunities throughout East and Southwest Texas. Its portfolio of projects encompasses the Bateman project, located across Bastrop and Caldwell counties, the Benton Field in Navarro County, and the Del Monte Prospect within Zavalla County. Established in 2005, the company initially operated under the name Xsilent Solutions Inc. before officially rebranding as Saxon Capital Group, Inc. in June 2015. Its corporate headquarters are situated in Scottsdale, Arizona.
